title: RiVaT-Fuse: Reliability-Calibrated Variational Tensor Fusion for Multimodal Prediction under Modality Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2609.10798v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Image-metadata prediction requires fusing heterogeneous evidence whose reliability can vary across samples and latent factors. Existing representation-level fusion methods typically choose an aggregation architecture, such as concatenation, gating, conditional modulation, or attention, without explicitly defining what the fused representation should mean under modality uncertainty. We propose RiVaT-Fuse, a reliability-calibrated variational tensor fusion framework that defines fusion as sample-wise latent-state estimation. Rather than producing a fused vector by direct aggregation, RiVaT-Fuse estimates a consensus latent state through a variational objective that balances image evidence, metadata evidence, structured cross-modal interaction, and stability. translated_title: RiVaT-Fuse：面向模态不确定性下多模态预测的可靠性校准变分张量融合
translated_abstract: 图像-元数据预测需要融合异构证据，而这些证据的可靠性可能因样本和潜在因素而异。现有的表示级融合方法通常只是选择一种聚合架构，例如拼接、门控、条件调制或注意力机制，而没有明确定义在模态不确定性下融合表示应当具有的含义。我们提出了RiVaT-Fuse，这是一个可靠性校准的变分张量融合框架，它将融合定义为样本级的潜在状态估计问题。RiVaT-Fuse并非通过直接聚合产生融合向量，而是通过变分目标来估计一个共识潜在状态，该目标平衡了图像证据、元数据证据、结构化跨模态交互以及稳定性。由此产生的框架用矩阵值信任几何取代了标量模态置信度，将跨模态交互分解为加性、乘性和关系性组件，并耦合……
tldr: RiVaT-Fuse将多模态融合重新定义为样本级潜在状态估计问题，通过变分目标平衡图像与元数据证据，并利用矩阵值信任几何和分解式跨模态交互来处理模态不确定性。
en_tdlr: RiVaT-Fuse redefines multimodal fusion as sample-wise latent-state estimation through a variational objective that balances image and metadata evidence, using matrix-valued trust geometry and decomposed cross-modal interactions to handle modality uncertainty.
